problem_context.problem_statement:
# DLL/SLL unqualified proof surface

User requirement: make active double-link and single-link verification artifacts avoid repeated `DLL::` / `DLL.` and `SLL::` / `SLL.` qualifiers, following the frozen `origin/idnode` pattern. Preserve every C executable token, mathematical definition, contract meaning, witness statement modulo transparent name qualification, and proof argument. Do not change algorithms or spatial predicates.

For active DLL cases, add `/*@ Import Coq Import DLL */` to the target C annotation context after the common library is available, then replace `DLL::name` with unqualified `name` in C annotations. The corresponding generated Rocq files must resolve those unqualified identifiers to the same `DLL.name` constants. Proof bodies and case-local libraries should also use `Import DLL.` and unqualified names so active proof artifacts contain no repeated `DLL.` qualifiers. Do not add `Export DLL`, aliases, axioms, admitted proofs, or new semantic definitions.

The established idmanager reference is `/home/yangfp/QCIP/crtosverify` branch `origin/idnode`: `annotated_C/src/id.h` imports `DLL` and uses unqualified `DL_Node`, `Build_DL_Node`, `store_dll`, `dllseg`, and `getData`; generated goals and manual proofs also `Import DLL` and use unqualified names. Follow that model.

Current SLL active cases already use global `xizi_sll*` definitions and expose no concrete `Module SLL`; audit them as regression-only and do not invent an SLL module or change their mathematical definitions. If any active SLL artifact contains `SLL::` or `SLL.`, remove it only through an existing `Import SLL` scope and preserve the resolved constant. Historical reports, snapshots, rec/combination/callpoint cases, upstream `crtos`, and `crtosverify` are read-only references and outside mutation scope.

Use the controller workflow required by root AGENTS.md. Canonical symexec must record its actual driver, cwd, `-IQCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/`, `-slp QCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ SimpleC.EE.QCP_demos_LLM`, common mapping, and `--CRules CRules`. Generated files may only be refreshed by symexec. Reuse the current accepted proof bodies as read-only proof patterns, changing only transparent qualification where needed. Final acceptance requires freshness, full fixed `coqc_check`, no `Admitted.` or extra `Axiom`, no forbidden lemma, and no active DLL/SLL qualifier in the assigned case's C, goal, case_lib, or manual proof except module declaration/import lines and any explicitly audited compatibility identity statement outside the case.
